name: get_mission_brief
description: Read the assigned brief once at the start, then only for new business facts, changed constraints, or immediately before an offer. Reuse the result for identity questions and greetings. Follow conversation.action; end means close politely without another tool call.

name: report_observation
description: Save one new relevant business fact from this call. Generate a stable key yourself; never ask the participant for tool arguments. Do not record greetings or repeat an already saved fact.

key.description: Stable operation ID generated by you, not the caller.

text.description: The new business fact or essential missing detail.

name: submit_offer
description: Save the participant’s actual quote after refreshing the brief. JSON fields: key,revision,terms with priceMinor integer paise,currency INR,description,confirmation reported or confirmed,optional capacity integer,readyAt ISO with offset,setupMinutes integer. Generate key yourself. INR 5500 is 550000 paise. Never invent missing terms.

payload_json.description: Save the participant’s actual quote after refreshing the brief. JSON fields: key,revision,terms with priceMinor integer paise,currency INR,description,confirmation reported or confirmed,optional capacity integer,readyAt ISO with offset,setupMinutes integer. Generate key yourself. INR 5500 is 550000 paise. Never invent missing terms. Encode the object as JSON; never include a token.

name: request_clarification
description: Record a missing essential organizer/service detail or callback request for the mission owner, then end politely. This does not arrange a callback. Generate a stable key yourself; never ask the participant for tool arguments.

key.description: Stable operation ID generated by you, not the caller.

text.description: The new business fact or essential missing detail.
